# Databricks notebook helpers on this PC

<!-- Generated by sidecar/fabric_desktop/databricks_notebook_helpers.py. Don't edit by hand: run
     `python -m fabric_desktop.databricks_notebook_helpers` in sidecar/ and commit the result. -->

What a Databricks notebook's `dbutils` calls and `%` magic commands do when the notebook runs on
this PC:

- **Runs**: as in Databricks.
- **Differs**: runs, with the difference noted.
- **Refused**: stops with an error that says why, so nothing is skipped quietly. Run the
  notebook in Fabric, or change the call.
- **Missing**: not on this PC's `dbutils` yet.

Each `dbutils` status comes from the `dbutils` the kernel builds, and CI regenerates this page,
so it changes when a call is added or refused.

| Helpers | Runs | Differs | Refused | Missing |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| dbutils | 13 | 16 | 7 | 0 |
| Cell magics | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| Line magics | 0 | 4 | 0 | 0 |

## dbutils

| Helper | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dbutils.credentials.assumeRole` | Refused | AWS role credentials are a Databricks on AWS feature; this PC signs in to Microsoft as you. |
| `dbutils.credentials.showCurrentRole` | Refused | AWS role credentials are a Databricks on AWS feature; this PC signs in to Microsoft as you. |
| `dbutils.credentials.showRoles` | Refused | AWS role credentials are a Databricks on AWS feature; this PC signs in to Microsoft as you. |
| `dbutils.data.summarize` | Differs | Shows a summary table of the DataFrame; the precise flag is ignored. |
| `dbutils.fs.cp` | Differs | Paths are the attached lakehouse (Files/...) or file: paths on this PC. dbfs:/, /Volumes/ and other bare absolute paths are Databricks storage and are refused by name. |
| `dbutils.fs.head` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. |
| `dbutils.fs.ls` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. |
| `dbutils.fs.mkdirs` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. |
| `dbutils.fs.mount` | Refused | Mounting storage runs in Databricks. On this PC, read the attached lakehouse. |
| `dbutils.fs.mounts` | Differs | Returns an empty list: there are no mounts on this PC. |
| `dbutils.fs.mv` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. A folder moves whole, so recurse is not needed. |
| `dbutils.fs.put` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. |
| `dbutils.fs.refreshMounts` | Differs | Does nothing and returns True: there are no mounts on this PC. |
| `dbutils.fs.rm` | Differs | Same paths as fs.cp. |
| `dbutils.fs.unmount` | Refused | Mounting storage runs in Databricks. On this PC, read the attached lakehouse. |

## Cell magics

| Helper | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `%python` | Runs |  |
| `%sql` | Differs | Runs on this PC's Spark SQL (DuckDB with Spark's functions). |
| `%md` | Runs |  |
| `%sh` | Differs | Runs as a script on this PC, not on a cluster driver. |
| `%scala` | Refused | Scala and R cells need Fabric's Spark. Switch Runs on to Fabric to run them. |
| `%r` | Refused | Scala and R cells need Fabric's Spark. Switch Runs on to Fabric to run them. |

## Line magics

| Helper | Status | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `%run` | Differs | Runs a notebook from this PC's notebooks folder in the same session. |
| `%fs` | Differs | ls, head, cp, mv, rm, mkdirs and put, with the same paths as dbutils.fs. A drive path (C:\data) is also taken. |
| `%pip` | Differs | Installs into the notebook's own environment on this PC, never the engine's. Your organization's policy can turn installs off. |
| `%sh` | Differs | Runs on this PC. |

Source: Databricks Utilities reference (docs.databricks.com/dev-tools/databricks-utils) and the notebook magic commands Databricks notebooks take (%python, %sql, %scala, %r, %md, %sh, %fs, %run, %pip).
